Method of Attack: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (Stored XSS) allowing injection of malicious scripts in product database entries, leading to site takeover by adding admin accounts and redirecting admins and visitors to malicious sites
Impacted Systems: WordPress sites using WP Product Review Lite plugin
Attack Vector: Bypassing WordPress user input data sanitization to inject malicious scripts remotely by unauthenticated attackers
Date of Discovery: May 13, 2023 (reported by Sucuri Labs, fixed May 14, 2023)
